dedupe_keys.name: electricity transmission grid optimization part of the open ego project etrago

description: Electricity Transmission Grid Optimization (part of the open_eGo project) (eTraGo) is a model listed in Open Energy Platform model and framework factsheets, a public register of energy-system model and framework factsheets under the section "Models", published or maintained by ZNES Flensburg (ZNES), DLR Institute of Networked Energy Systems (DLR). eTraGo aims at optimizing power plant and storage dispatch under consideration of transmission grid constraints. The high-voltage grid (110 kV) is considered as a part of the transmission grid. Investments for grid and storage expansion can be optimized. Coverage: Germany. Time resolution: hour. Spatial resolution: national states, TSO regions, federal states, regions, NUTS 3, districts, power stations. Software: Python, PyPSA, scikit-learn, pandas, sqlalchemy, oemof.db, geoalchemy2, ego.io, matplotlib. The listed link gives the source code or documentation; nothing was downloaded or run. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is GNU Affero General Public License v3.0. Caveats: this record was written from the Open Energy Platform factsheet only, so the code, documentation and any publication it links were not opened, their current availability was not checked, and the factsheet may lag the project. It can support energy-system planning and scenario studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-oep-factsheet-catalogue.
